topic: Christianity: Beliefs, Marriage & the Family, Living the Christian Life, Matters of Life & Death (Spec A)
subject: religious-studies

items.q: Do all religious believers hold identical views on family and relationships?
items.correct: No — teachings and interpretations differ between and within religions.
items.why: Views on marriage, gender roles, contraception and divorce vary considerably.

items.q: Do all religions forbid contraception and divorce outright?
items.correct: No — views vary by religion and denomination; many permit them in circumstances.
items.random_wrong: No religion has any teaching on these.
items.why: Believers interpret teachings differently on family-life issues.

specSource: Pearson Edexcel GCSE Religious Studies A (1RA0) specification; Christianity: Beliefs, Marriage & the Family, Living the Christian Life, Matters of Life & Death (Spec A)
